facts.text: It started the night after my last filgrastim dose.
Today is the fourth day of the fever.

facts.item: fever: relief from acetaminophen and levofloxacin
facts.text: The acetaminophen and levofloxacin I was prescribed as an outpatient didn't get rid of it; I still have the fever.
After my operation I had chemotherapy with paclitaxel and carboplatin, and I've completed all six cycles.
After my fifth and sixth cycles my blood counts dropped (myelosuppression).
Because of that I was given filgrastim, 75 micrograms a day: for 3 days after the fifth cycle and for 4 days after the sixth.
When the fever started I was prescribed acetaminophen as an outpatient.
I was also prescribed the antibiotic levofloxacin as an outpatient.
I haven't had any chest pain.
I haven't had any abdominal pain.
I haven't had any problems with my vision.
